text: The HSBC brand belongs to the HSBC Group, whose principal holding company, HSBC Holdings plc, is a public limited company incorporated in England, headquartered in London and listed on the London, Hong Kong, New York and Bermuda stock exchanges.
short: HSBC is the brand of HSBC Holdings plc, a listed UK company.

source.name: HSBC: Investors — Group structure
source.quote: Our principal holding company, HSBC Holdings plc, is a public limited company incorporated in England.
